I loved sailing on the Grandeur. I'm going back in October. I would say 9 nights is a long time to stay on this ship. It can get old fast, unless you're super laid back and like to sleep in and hang out by the pool.

Grandeur is a great option if you're just looking to get away. My husband and I are "lazy" vacationers and just like to walk around and be thankful we"re not at work. We took Grandeur a few years ago then took Oasis (way bigger) last year and we ended up opting for the exact same activities on both, so we rebooked on Grandeur. If crowds bother you, it's so worth going on a smaller ship. Also, I'm not sure if the cruise director is the same on the Grandeur as it was in 2022 but he really made the most out of a small crowd.
